set.body: Document the ScalaFIM surface architecture and migration stance: what maps from neurosurf, what is intentionally not ported, index conventions, module boundaries, public imports, examples for geometry/fields/geodesics/parcels/IO, and implementation checklist. Acceptance: modules/surface/README.md is useful standalone, docs/ecosystem-port.md mentions the surface module, and examples avoid plotting-centric language. Likely paths: modules/surface/README.md, docs/ecosystem-port.md, README.md.
set.title: Surface module docs and migration guide
